cases.description: If the code verifier differs from the stored challenge, the token endpoint will reject the exchange. This statement describes the rule and does not identify the reason for this rejection.
This request was rejected because its redirect address does not match the callback address registered for the client application.
We rejected this token request because the submitted code verifier does not match the code challenge stored for this authorization.
The supplied verifier matched the stored challenge. A verifier mismatch was not the cause of this rejection. No other cause is stated.
The authorization code has expired. Its expiration is the reason this code exchange was rejected.
For example, a server could reject a request because the verifier does not match its challenge. That example is not a statement about why this request was rejected.
The client secret supplied with this exchange is incorrect for the registered application, so client authentication failed and the request was rejected.
For this exchange, the supplied verifier was compared with the challenge attached to the authorization. The comparison failed, and that mismatch caused the token request to be denied.
This exchange was rejected either because the authorization code expired or because the verifier did not match its challenge. The response does not determine which of these caused the rejection.
This authorization code was already redeemed. Reuse of that code caused the present exchange to be denied.
The submitted verifier matched the stored challenge and no mismatch occurred. The submitted verifier did not match that same challenge, and this mismatch caused the rejection.
This application is not configured to use the requested authorization flow. That client configuration restriction caused the token request to be rejected.
This exchange was rejected because the submitted code verifier
The proof supplied in this request does not reproduce the challenge saved when authorization was granted. This failed verifier check is why the server refused to exchange the code.
The authorization grant was revoked before this exchange. The server rejected the request because the grant is no longer valid.
The code exchange could not be completed. No reason for the rejection is available in this message.
